sources.details: 8x4=32 positions per strip; 2x32=64 affected RGB positions; red and blue channels change, green does not:64x2=128. Each8x8cell has64positions:32/64 red,0/64 green,32/64 blue=(0.5,0,0.5). Permuting within a cell preserves its sum. Moving red into adjacent cell gives first(0,0,0.5),second(0.5,0,0),global totals(32,0,32). Identical pooled inputs cannot uniquely identify these different originals. Derivation and no-guarantee label example are in reviewer-notes.md.
